parameters.name: All
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to remove all tags from the specified resource groups or members. Valid values:

*   false (default)
*   true

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region in which the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance is deployed. Valid values:

*   **cn-hangzhou**: Chinese mainland.
*   **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Set the value to ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE.

parameters.name: TagKey
parameters.description: The tag keys. You can specify up to 20 tag keys.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi untag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-type ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE --all false --resource-id demo.xxxxaliyundoc.com-waf --tag-key demoTagKey --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun waf-openapi UntagResources --region cn-hangzhou --All false --ResourceId.1 'demo.xxxxaliyundoc.com-waf' --TagKey.1 demoTagKey --ResourceType 'ALIYUN::WAF::DEFENSERESOURCE' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
